shared: Snake actors whose deaths are acts: each death fires its effect, and the body usually gets back up.
differ: What a fake death leads to: a count cashed next turn, a whole-cast comeback, or understudies stepping in.

takes.label: The death counter
takes.line: You cue deaths yourself, like the Villain's murder; every fake death feeds one count, cashed as permanent stats next turn.
takes.look_if: a climbing count you push yourself, paid out next turn.

takes.label: The second act
takes.line: Downed units lie limp until the whole cast is down, then all stand up at full Health, bigger from Bufo.
takes.look_if: one big comeback where the whole cast rises at once.

takes.label: Leads and understudies
takes.line: Back-row Understudies step into fallen leads' slots, the Prompter's Boy doubles whoever stands in front, and Notices count every death all game.
takes.look_if: a readable death-effect board where front and back rows matter.
